clauses.quote: Smoking and other tobacco use shall be prohibited on school system property, all school sponsored events at any time and/or on school vehicles at all times.
"No smoking" signs shall be placed prominently throughout the buildings on school system property and vehicles.
clauses.notes: Implicit duty on district administration to install compliance signage.

clauses.quote: Supervisor and/ or principal will inform the superintendent in writing of the violation.
The superintendent will write a letter of reprimand, with a copy given to the employee and the original placed in the employee's personnel folder at Central Office.
The superintendent will write a letter of reprimand, which includes a statement requiring the mandatory attendance and completion of our district's Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
A copy of this letter will be given to the employee and the original placed in the employee's personnel folder in the Central Office.
